title: Director film (pixel-world explainer, 2 min)
about: The creator's own mascot acts every line in a voxel pixel world: a real-world meadow opening that drops into the pixel world through a screen, 23 chapters as long takes, depth typography, generated icons and real footage on screens, six songs cast by meaning with a cappella moments. Approved by the user (v5) and exported as a 4:5-in-9:16 reel.
needs: the voxel-starter assets (vm assets reuse); songs are NOT included (bring your own, see score.sh)
